title: Cesar Gonzalez - Staff Writer
contentHtml: I’m Cesar. Most of the time you can find me posted at my couch playing Dark Souls or on my guitar, ripping off whatever band I’m obsessed with that week. I also would very much like to be a writer or a teacher one day, so I go to university at Southern Connecticut State for English as well as for Secondary Education. If I really had to pick a favorite genre, I’d probably choose metalcore, but I also enjoy metal, hardcore, emo, etc. ​
